appsAndFeaturesEntries.DisplayName: Rain Cleaner - Driver Installer, Cleaning and Game Booster

en-US.description: Windows cleaner, driver installer and ransomware guard that explains every change before it makes it. Free, with an optional Pro upgrade.
en-US.longDescription:
Rain Cleaner checks what is taking up space, which drivers are out of date and what starts
with Windows. Then it shows you what it found and why, and you decide what changes.

Cleaning comes with a reason for every item, so you can see what you lose before anything
is deleted. Drivers come from Microsoft's own catalogue, and when a manufacturer has a
newer one, the program says so instead of hosting anything itself. A game booster frees
resources while you play and puts every setting back afterwards; it never suspends or kills
a process. Emergency drivers get the network working again on a PC that cannot get online.
Ransomware protection places decoy files in your folders so encryption is caught early.

What it does not do: it is not an antivirus and does not replace one, and it cannot make
your internet connection faster - it can only measure which DNS server answers fastest.

Windows 10, Windows 11 and Windows Server. The free version has no time limit, no ads and
needs no account. An optional paid Pro upgrade adds one-click tools (Fix My PC, Update
Everything, Undo Anything, scheduled autopilot). The interface speaks 13 languages.
en-US.name: Rain Cleaner
en-US.releaseNotes: A new look, and progress you can read: every long job now shows a real percentage, the step it is on and what it is working through, instead of a spinner. Where Windows itself cannot report progress, the program says so in plain words. New vector icons, a clearer button hierarchy and rewritten English texts. Nothing was removed and no price changed.
